resolutions.researcher_notes: Original current_ref (fgw.gxzf.gov.cn) is geo-blocked (ConnectTimeout on hostname and resolved IP) with no wayback snapshot (archive.org availability check returned empty). Leaving UNRESOLVED — no fabricated URL, no independent confirmation of ProposalYear=2021/ProposalMonth=3 found.

Recorded StartYear1=2024/StartMonth1=1 (January 2024) is not supported by anything found, and what was found disagrees rather than confirms: gxbhlg.com documents a gas-in/pressure-test milestone completed 2024-03-29, and nengyuanquan.com documents the official commissioning/first-gas-to-customers milestone on 2024-08-19 — both real, well-sourced 2024 dates, but neither is January. Per standing rule, a value disagreement is not resolved by attaching a ref that supports a different date — leaving UNRESOLVED rather than proposing refs for month=8 or month=3. The deep-sweep audit shard already flagged this same conflict as a proposed correction (StartMonth1 1->8) pending human review; this ref-sweep unit is left unresolved for the same reason, consistent with the audit.

Original current_ref (fgw.gxzf.gov.cn) geo-blocked, no snapshot. The only capacity figure found, nengyuanquan.com's '满负荷运营状态下...年供气量可达近20亿立方米' (full-load annual supply of nearly 2 billion cubic meters, i.e. ~2 bcm/y), is a rounded press-release approximation that is ~12% off the recorded Capacity=1.76 bcm/y — not a clean confirmation of the precise figure. Both sources trace to the same project-developer origin, so tier=medium, independent=false (matches the audit shard's own prior fill for this same cell).
